agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario is a single fast body (vx≈38.9 m/s, dt≈0.0157, no walls) moving toward the right arena boundary. At step 21 the body is still inside (x≈18.95, overshoot negative) but by step 22 it has translated beyond the 20-wide arena (x≈19.57, r≈0.82, overshoot≈0.39 >0.15 limit) with no bounce or clamping. Despite 21 substeps per step, the displacement per step (≈0.61 m) is enough to carry the centre from well inside to beyond the boundary in one step with no collision response for the implicit arena walls, so the in_arena invariant is violated. Reducing initial speed removes the escape.
